prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Layout Split View: Re-layouts the sign-in screen into a side-by-side split view highlighting account safety and cloud pet backups.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Sign in to Save Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Keep your pet safely backed up to your account across devices."}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Photo Upload Stage Redesign: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a stage view with clear upload area replace components.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "stage", "replace": {"photo_upload": [{"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Select clear front-facing pet photos", "style": "emphasis", "role": "photo_upload"}]}}}
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Onboarding Path Overview Screen: Inserts an explicit path overview screen right before choosing a path to clarify adoption options.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_overview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_overview": {"headline": "Choose How to Create Your Pet", "body": "Pick a premade companion or generate a unique pet from your own photos.", "layout": "card"}}
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Generation Progress Time Estimate: Enables animated progress, explicit time estimates, and helpful tips on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "hint": "We are generating your desktop companion..."}}
4: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Overview: Replaces the home welcome banner with a visual quick control checklist illustrating pet interactions and hotkeys.
   config: {"home_intro": {"replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right click pet to summon menu; Drag to move; Double click to talk", "style": "playful", "role": "home_welcome"}]}}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Adds a prominent notice explaining how signing into an existing account restores existing pet profiles.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Already created a pet? Sign in with the same account to automatically restore your saved companion."}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Custom Pet Generation Quality Tips: Adds tip cards and clarity badges on the photo upload screen explaining how to get ideal pet rendering results.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Best Results: Bright lighting & solo pet photos", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Setup Readiness Sub Flow: Adds a sub-flow before finishing to ensure the desktop overlay permissions are ready before launching.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_readiness", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_readiness": {"headline": "Preparing Desktop Overlay", "body": "Checking window management permissions to ensure your pet walks freely on your screen.", "layout": "centered"}}
8: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Choice Headline Clarification: Updates headline and body to clearly differentiate standard pet adoption versus custom photo pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Adopt Instant Pet or Generate Custom Pet", "body": "Choose 'Instant' to pick a companion right now, or 'Custom' to turn your pet's photo into your companion."}}
9: [home, notification] Background Generation Ready Alert: Adds an opt-in system notification toggle so users can minimize the app while pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Your Pet is Being Created", "body": "You can safely minimize this window. We'll notify you as soon as your companion is ready!"}}
